name: Agrius
source:
Agrius is going to be a tale of drama, coming of age, betrayal, and love between Cooper, a human that is transported to an unknown world of anthro hyena men, and Rei, the shaman in the tribe.

How is a meager, vulnerable human going to survive in a world of hyena grunts that are looking for a snack at every turn? Read about tribal politics in this story of a small group of warrior beast men governed by an airheaded fool alongside his incompetent son whose jealousy and narcissism could become lethal. Can you trust those closest to you? Will you win the heart of Rei, or will you be killed mercilessly once you have your back turned to the tribe?... or will there be another heart to win?

[From [url=https://skaifur.itch.io/agrius]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《阿格里乌斯》将讲述库珀（一个被传送到一个由人类鬣狗人组成的未知世界的人类）和雷（部落萨满）之间的戏剧、成长、背叛和爱情的故事。

一个贫穷、脆弱的人类如何在鬣狗到处寻找零食的世界中生存？在这个故事中了解部落政治，讲述了一小群野兽战士，由一个愚蠢的傻瓜和他无能的儿子统治，而儿子的嫉妒和自恋可能会致命。你能相信那些最亲近的人吗？你会赢得雷伊的心，还是会在背对部落后被无情地杀死？……或者还会有另一颗心可以赢得吗？

[来自[url=https://skaifur.itch.io/agrius]Itch.io[/url]]
